instruction.text: What is communication? Select the correct answer.

b: ++Communication is when people share ideas, information or messages.
Communication is when people spend time alone to relax.

instruction.text: What are the different ways people communicate? Select all the correct answers.

feedback.end: Humans can communicate in many ways. We use spoken and written language, but we can also communicate without words by using body language and facial expressions.

instruction.text: What is respectful communication, and why is it important? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Respectful communication helps to make everyone feel ((++valued vain)) and seen.
It involves taking turns to talk and showing ((++interest ignorance)) through eye contact and body language.
It also means listening carefully when others are speaking and trying to ((++understand criticise)) their feelings.
However, this does not mean you have to say yes to everything. It’s ((++okay bad)) to say no and have boundaries.

instruction.text: Which phrases are examples of respectful communication? Drag them to the correct group.

atoms.b: Could you pass me the salt, please?
